onEnter.speaker: char_xiaozhi
onEnter.t: If you need any errands done, just come to me, Sis.

onEnter.speaker: char_andy
onEnter.t: Leave any park-related investigation to me!

onEnter.speaker: char_xiaozhi
onEnter.t: If you need us to look into something, just show us the evidence and tell us what to check. We'll dig deeper for you, Sis!

onEnter.speaker: char_qin
onEnter.t: After you've finished questioning and organizing the clues, come see me. We'll review the clues together.

introDialogue.speaker: none
introDialogue.t: October 29, 2025, 12:30 PM, Chaoye Park, Haunted House Entrance

introDialogue.speaker: none
introDialogue.t: Lyra Qin looks at you. It seems she has something to say.

introDialogue.speaker: char_qin
introDialogue.t: Sylva, we have made some new progress in the investigation.

introDialogue.speaker: char_qin
introDialogue.t: One of our officers wanted to use surveillance footage to check whether any of the haunted house visitors at the time looked suspicious. Unfortunately, the queue area is blocked by an awning, and the exit footage only shows people from behind, so faces cannot be identified.

introDialogue.speaker: char_qin
introDialogue.t: But there was an unexpected lead. We found that the phone reported missing by a visitor on the day of the incident was indeed stolen.

introDialogue.speaker: char_qin
introDialogue.t: A man who came out of the exit appeared two hours later at a rest pavilion near the haunted house, bent down, and put something into the grass. That is suspicious.

introDialogue.speaker: char_qin
introDialogue.t: After comparing the footage with the gate guards and investigating, we found this pickpocket. His name is Anton Han. The strange thing is, he has no theft record at all. In other words, he is not a habitual offender.

introDialogue.speaker: char_qin
introDialogue.t: Also, regarding the public outcry caused by an actor being harassed, our investigation found that the person involved has already deleted the post. The officers found netizens who saw it back then and took screenshots, allowing us to reconstruct the key information.

introDialogue.speaker: char_qin
introDialogue.t: In addition, one very careful officer called the hospital where Faye's mother was supposedly hospitalized. The hospital said there was no admission record for that patient during those two days. In other words, Faye lied.

introDialogue.speaker: char_qin
introDialogue.t: Under those circumstances, Faye was suspected of fabricating an alibi together with her mother. So we checked Faye's itinerary again and found that she did not lie about her trip.

introDialogue.speaker: char_qin
introDialogue.t: She did buy only two tickets, one outbound and one return, and both have ride records. In other words, her suspicion can basically be cleared. But for now, we still do not know why she lied.

introDialogue.speaker: char_qin
introDialogue.t: We also investigated Daniel Xiao's relationships before his death. His parents and family are not in this city, and there are no travel records showing them coming to or leaving this city, so they can be ruled out as suspects.

introDialogue.speaker: char_qin
introDialogue.t: Daniel Xiao once had a fiancée named Lynn Zhao. Their former neighbors said that after Daniel died, Lynn was heartbroken and soon moved away from this city, seemingly returning to her hometown to live.

introDialogue.speaker: char_qin
introDialogue.t: At the same time, we also looked into the Victor's girlfriend. Her name is Orchid Ru, and she works at an animal rescue center in this city.

introDialogue.speaker: char_qin
introDialogue.t: The pickpocket Anton Han and Ru should both be in the Interrogation Area. You can talk to them later.

char_qin.speaker: char_qin
char_qin.t: If you find anything new, tell me about it.

char_andy.speaker: char_andy
char_andy.t: Leave any park-related investigation to me!

char_xiaozhi.speaker: char_xiaozhi
char_xiaozhi.t: The best detective assistant, Sidney, is sincerely at your service!

char_antong.speaker: char_antong
char_antong.t: I know I was wrong, okay! I returned the stuff too, so please do not arrest me!

char_rulan.speaker: none
char_rulan.t: Orchid Ru's eyes are red and swollen, and she looks extremely worn out. She probably has not slept much these past two days.

dialogue.speaker: char_qin
dialogue.t: How did the questioning go?

dialogue.speaker: char_qin
dialogue.t: Let us start with Daniel Xiao's death three years ago. Based on your investigation, what exactly happened that day?

dialogue.speaker: char_qin
dialogue.t: I see.

dialogue.speaker: char_qin
dialogue.t: Then, in the incident from three years ago, what is the truth behind the anonymous post and Celeste Ming's harassment incident?

dialogue.speaker: char_qin
dialogue.t: That makes everything fit.

dialogue.speaker: char_qin
dialogue.t: Why did the pickpocket we caught put the stolen items in the grass?

dialogue.speaker: char_qin
dialogue.t: I did not expect this matter to be connected to Victor's death too.

dialogue.speaker: char_qin
dialogue.t: So, what evidence or testimony can we use to rule out some of the suspects?

dialogue.speaker: char_qin
dialogue.t: I see. That means the culprit may have entered the haunted house as a visitor on the night of the incident.

dialogue.speaker: char_qin
dialogue.t: Regarding Daniel Xiao's girlfriend, Lynn Zhao, did you discover anything noteworthy?

dialogue.speaker: char_qin
dialogue.t: Although we cannot confirm this information right now, it may be useful later. Also, do you think there is a problem with Victor's girlfriend's alibi?

dialogue.speaker: none
dialogue.t: She gave me the ticket stub for the movie that night.

dialogue.speaker: char_qin
dialogue.t: She previously gave our officer a statement about what happened that night. By the way, did you find the schedule for that cinema that day?

dialogue.speaker: none
dialogue.t: Yes, it is right here.

dialogue.speaker: char_qin
dialogue.t: Good. Then we can compare the testimonies.

dialogue.speaker: char_qin
dialogue.t: Also, why did Faye lie about her itinerary? Who killed Victor Jiang? How did the killer do it? I believe you already have the answers.

dialogue.speaker: char_qin
dialogue.t: Then next, tomorrow will be the moment when the final truth is revealed.

dialogue.speaker: char_qin
dialogue.t: Let us stop here for today! Tomorrow, stay fully focused and clear up every last doubt in one go!

dialogue.speaker: char_xiaozhi
dialogue.t: Twenty times fully focused!

dialogue.speaker: none
dialogue.t: Haha, I am ready!

dialogue.speaker: none
dialogue.t: After leaving the Interrogation Area, you sorted through the important clues you had just heard in your mind.

dialogue.speaker: none
dialogue.t: Daniel Xiao's death three years ago was an accident disguised as a suicide. To protect himself, Victor Jiang had Aiden Li, who obeyed him completely at the time, fake the scene.

dialogue.speaker: none
dialogue.t: Sunny was the person involved in that public-opinion scandal. The person she originally accused in her post was someone else, and after Victor Jiang's radical actions, she felt she had to do something to repay him.

dialogue.speaker: none
dialogue.t: Faye had a conflict with Victor. She lied about her mother being hospitalized, but her motive for lying is still unclear.

dialogue.speaker: none
dialogue.t: Then there are Aiden Li and Anton Han. They planned a clumsy theft, yet on that very day, Victor Jiang died.

dialogue.speaker: none
dialogue.t: You already have an answer about who the real killer is, but many questions still linger in your mind.

dialogue.speaker: none
dialogue.t: Tomorrow will be the moment when the whole truth is revealed. And you're ready for it.

t_andy_public_outcry.title: The Public Outcry Three Years Ago

dialogue.speaker: char_andy
dialogue.t: Hey, are you still looking into the incident where Celeste Ming was exposed online?

dialogue.speaker: none
dialogue.t: Yes. Celeste Ming clearly said he never did anything like that, and people generally have not reported experiencing his behave inappropriately.

dialogue.speaker: none
dialogue.t: In the screenshot Lyra Qin provided, the poster Uka accused a certain park executive without naming anyone. Is it possible she was not referring to Celeste Ming at all?

dialogue.speaker: none
dialogue.t: The poster's current answer is so ambiguous that it is actually somewhat suspicious. We need to pin down exactly who the poster is, and who she was accusing.

dialogue.speaker: char_andy
dialogue.t: Okay. Besides the people currently being questioned, do you have anyone else in mind to investigate?

dialogue.speaker: none
dialogue.t: Lena Qiu and Gwen Gao. I want to learn more about these two people.

dialogue.speaker: none
dialogue.t: Andy lowered his head and tapped on his phone.

dialogue.speaker: char_andy
dialogue.t: Got it! This is the information I could find. Lena Qiu, 27, worked in the park's food service department and was responsible for the drink stand. She left about a year and a half ago because of a new job opportunity; Gwen Gao, 24, was responsible for admission ticket checks and left half a year ago because she planned to prepare for the civil service exam.

dialogue.speaker: none
dialogue.t: Right, food service staff and ticket inspectors both need work uniforms, don't they?

dialogue.speaker: char_andy
dialogue.t: Yes. Generally, they have to wear them while in the park. There are two sets, one with skirts and one with pants.

dialogue.speaker: none
dialogue.t: What about the actors in the performance department?

dialogue.speaker: char_andy
dialogue.t: They also have their own costumes, but the dress code is not quite as strict.

dialogue.speaker: char_andy
dialogue.t: After the period when the post was made, two executives left. One was Jasper Wang from the administrative team, and the other was Celeste Ming. Since then, there do not seem to have been any similar rumors.

dialogue.speaker: char_xiaozhi
dialogue.t: Is there anything I can help with, sis?

dialogue.speaker: none
dialogue.t: I need to confirm Orchid Ru's alibi. For example, we can ask the cinema staff whether Orchid Ru really had her ticket checked and appeared at the theater. You can take her photo with you.

dialogue.speaker: none
dialogue.t: About 30 minutes later, Sidney returned. It seems a one-way trip between the cinema and the haunted house takes a little over ten minutes.

dialogue.speaker: char_xiaozhi
dialogue.t: Sis, I checked with the ticket inspector from that night. Because it was during the holiday and also a weekend, those screenings were especially crowded. She doesn't remember the faces of the people whose tickets she checked at all.

dialogue.speaker: char_xiaozhi
dialogue.t: But the ticket inspector recognized Orchid Ru because midway through the film, she came out of the screening room to use the restroom. There weren't many people in the lobby then, so she stood out. She looked like she had diarrhea and had a very bad complexion, and only came back after more than ten minutes.

dialogue.speaker: none
dialogue.t: Nice work!

dialogue.speaker: char_xiaozhi
dialogue.t: If you need anything, please come find me again!

dialogue.speaker: char_xiaozhi
dialogue.t: Sidney, the best detective assistant, sincerely at your service!

dialogue.speaker: none
dialogue.t: Orchid Ru said that midway through the movie, she went to the restroom because her stomach hurt. At that point, the movie was probably around the scene after the Pumpkin King stole the magic wand. Could you help me confirm roughly how many minutes after the start that scene happens?

dialogue.speaker: none
dialogue.t: After a short while.

dialogue.speaker: char_xiaozhi
dialogue.t: I got it! That scene happens about 40 minutes after the film starts.

dialogue.speaker: none
dialogue.t: In other words, around 19:10, Orchid Ru came out of the screening room to use the restroom.

dialogue.speaker: char_xiaozhi
dialogue.t: So that means she can be ruled out as a suspect.

dialogue.speaker: none
dialogue.t: It looks that way... but I still have one doubt. Could you help me check Yaohua Cinema's screening schedule that night?

dialogue.speaker: char_xiaozhi
dialogue.t: That's easy! A quick check will tell us!

dialogue.speaker: char_antong
dialogue.t: Come on, let me go already. I left the park empty-handed! Strictly speaking, it should not count as stealing!

dialogue.speaker: none
dialogue.t: Stop making excuses. Taking something out of a visitor's pocket is theft! By the way, why did you put it back after stealing it?

dialogue.speaker: char_antong
dialogue.t: I heard something happened here! The performances were all stopped! I thought you were investigating me! Of course I put the phone back!

dialogue.speaker: none
dialogue.t: Did you know someone died?

dialogue.speaker: char_antong
dialogue.t: I did not know then, but I know now! It has nothing to do with me!

dialogue.speaker: none
dialogue.t: What did you steal? Tell me.

dialogue.speaker: char_antong
dialogue.t: Just one phone!

dialogue.speaker: none
dialogue.t: Only one phone? You did not secretly put these things there, did you?
dialogue.autoPresent: Point out the other items suspected of being stolen

dialogue.speaker: char_antong
dialogue.t: Of course not! We thieves have dignity! Stuff this cheap is not worth our time at all!

dialogue.speaker: none
dialogue.t: Speaking of that, I am curious too. Have you been a thief for a long time?

dialogue.speaker: char_antong
dialogue.t: Of course! Don't question my professional experience!

dialogue.speaker: none
dialogue.t: Then that is strange...
dialogue.autoPresent: Point out the evidence that can refute Anton

dialogue.speaker: none
dialogue.t: Why do the police not have a criminal record for you?

dialogue.speaker: char_antong
dialogue.t: Uh, that is because... I am a top-tier master thief! A super invincible technical expert! No one can catch me!

dialogue.speaker: none
dialogue.t: Then how did you get caught on surveillance camera? Did you not scout the place in advance?

dialogue.speaker: char_antong
dialogue.t: Aaaah... I got careless! Even a good horse stumbles!

dialogue.speaker: none
dialogue.t: Fine, stop pretending. All of this means...

options.text: A You are not a professional at all
B You were caught on camera on purpose

options.reply: I am not! That is slander!

dialogue.speaker: none
dialogue.t: You are not really in this line of work, are you? Tell me, what is the real reason you stole the phone? If you keep hemming and hawing, I will have Ms Qin detain you for seven days first.

dialogue.speaker: char_antong
dialogue.t: Ugh... you are so annoying!

dialogue.speaker: char_antong
dialogue.t: It is true that someone asked me to do it.

dialogue.speaker: char_antong
dialogue.t: But the reason is complicated. And I was not really trying to steal the phone and sell it for money. The main reason I did it was to attract attention, so everyone would investigate... a certain person.

dialogue.speaker: none
dialogue.t: A certain person? Who?

dialogue.speaker: char_antong
dialogue.t: It does not matter anymore...

dialogue.speaker: none
dialogue.t: You mean him, right? He is already dead, so it does not matter anymore.

dialogue.speaker: char_antong
dialogue.t: Y-yes.

dialogue.speaker: none
dialogue.t: Then I suspect the lipstick, hair clips, and other items in the cello case were actually things Victor stole from visitors, right?

dialogue.speaker: char_antong
dialogue.t: Mm... yeah.

dialogue.speaker: none
dialogue.t: But he never stole valuables, so visitors never reported anything. Or rather, by the time they noticed, they had usually already left the haunted house, and they couldn't be sure where they had lost the items.

dialogue.speaker: none
dialogue.t: A phone is different. People use it so often that once it was stolen, it would likely be discovered very quickly.

dialogue.speaker: none
dialogue.t: So you deliberately stole something easy to notice, hoping to frame the habitual offender Victor and lead the park to investigate him. Am I right?

dialogue.speaker: char_antong
dialogue.t: Y-yes...

dialogue.speaker: none
dialogue.t: You're not a park employee, so how do you know so much about Victor? This person must have told you, right?

choices.question: This person must have told you, right?

dialogue.speaker: char_antong
dialogue.t: Not necessarily. It could also have been that dancing girl, right?

dialogue.speaker: none
dialogue.t: It couldn't have been her. First, Aiden said that both Sunny and Victor were very unhappy about the bonus deductions. Also, one of Sunny's personal belongings had traces of a special habit on it, and coincidentally, Victor had the same habit.
dialogue.autoPresent: Point out what led you to this guess.

dialogue.speaker: none
dialogue.t: Judging from Sunny's locker, she and Victor shared the habit of stamping the park LOGO on paper. I'm afraid those were...

options.text: C The number of milk teas they drank
options.reply: That milk tea really is good!

dialogue.speaker: none
dialogue.t: Those were things they used to count the items they stole for themselves, right? I thought it was strange from the start. Why did both of their cases contain things like that, and why had Victor written dates beside them?

dialogue.speaker: none
dialogue.t: Only later did I connect the dots: perhaps the two of them were accomplices in this matter.

dialogue.speaker: char_antong
dialogue.t: Yes... You figured all of that out...

dialogue.speaker: char_antong
dialogue.t: Aiden is my buddy. He thought what those two were doing was very wrong, but he didn't have the courage to report it himself.

dialogue.speaker: char_antong
dialogue.t: So he asked me to help him steal something easy to discover, so the matter would be thoroughly investigated and exposed.

dialogue.speaker: char_antong
dialogue.t: I never expected Victor to die that night.

dialogue.speaker: char_antong
dialogue.t: Actually, I was pretty nervous. When I was in college, a mentor taught me a few pickpocket tricks. But I hadn't really done this much, so after Aiden asked me, I practiced for several days.

dialogue.speaker: char_antong
dialogue.t: That day, I went in during the third and fourth shows. During the third one, I couldn't find a chance to make a move, so I just pretended to be a visitor and came out empty-handed.

dialogue.speaker: char_antong
dialogue.t: During the fourth show, while lining up, I observed more carefully where everyone kept their belongings. After going in, I finally stole a phone in the dark and came out with it. I was so nervous my whole palm was sweating, and I kept close to the crowd the entire time.

dialogue.speaker: none
dialogue.t: Did you sense any sounds or anything unusual?

dialogue.speaker: char_antong
dialogue.t: No. When I walked from Spot 1 to Spot 2, I made sure to stay at the very back of the group. I also kept an eye on the people at the edges, in case Victor or Sunny were around. Luckily, neither of them was there the whole time, so I got through that part without any issues.

dialogue.speaker: char_antong
dialogue.t: Although, now that you mention it, there does seem to have been something a little strange...

dialogue.speaker: none
dialogue.t: What was it?

dialogue.speaker: char_antong
dialogue.t: I felt that at the exit, someone was walking behind me.

dialogue.speaker: none
dialogue.t: What?

dialogue.speaker: char_antong
dialogue.t: Because I was worried about being seen, I kept checking whether I was at the very end of the group. But when we were walking toward Spot 6, I realized there was still someone behind me.

dialogue.speaker: none
dialogue.t: What? Are you sure it wasn't an actor following you?

dialogue.speaker: char_antong
dialogue.t: I'm sure. I can recognize actors' costumes. Out of the corner of my eye, I saw... the person seemed to be just an ordinary visitor.

dialogue.speaker: char_rulan
dialogue.t: I... I was his girlfriend. We had been dating for over a year...

dialogue.speaker: char_rulan
dialogue.t: I thought he was a decent person... Although we weren't living together yet, we had plans for that...

dialogue.speaker: char_rulan
dialogue.t: I never expected something like this to happen...

dialogue.speaker: char_rulan
dialogue.t: He... most of his friends seemed to be park colleagues.

dialogue.speaker: none
dialogue.t: Who did he mention more often?

dialogue.speaker: char_rulan
dialogue.t: He didn't really mention his coworkers by name...

dialogue.speaker: char_rulan
dialogue.t: If we're talking about people he had conflicts with... he had a bad temper, and he got into some disputes with the neighbors from time to time...

dialogue.speaker: char_rulan
dialogue.t: I often heard him say he couldn't stand so-and-so, or that he'd argued with someone again... There were quite a lot of things like that. That temper really did cause him plenty of trouble...

dialogue.speaker: char_rulan
dialogue.t: As for me... after drinking, he'd lose his temper for no reason. Other than that, there wasn't much.

dialogue.speaker: none
dialogue.t: Then what happened to the wounds on your arms and hands?

dialogue.speaker: char_rulan
dialogue.t: Oh, those are from my cat. She gets a little feisty sometimes.

dialogue.speaker: char_rulan
dialogue.t: Even though it was Sunday, I was working a shift from 9 in the morning until 5 in the evening.

dialogue.speaker: char_rulan
dialogue.t: I knew Victor had performances around then and would be busy until pretty late, so I didn't bother him.

dialogue.speaker: none
dialogue.t: Have you ever watched their haunted house performance?

dialogue.speaker: char_rulan
dialogue.t: Ah... no... I'm rather scared of that sort of thing.

dialogue.speaker: none
dialogue.t: Then have you been there during the day?

dialogue.speaker: char_rulan
dialogue.t: During the day... yes, I went during the day. He showed me around his workplace a little.

dialogue.speaker: char_rulan
dialogue.t: Since it's Halloween season, I wanted to get into the holiday spirit, so after work I went to see a movie, Halloween Wonder Night.

dialogue.speaker: none
dialogue.t: Which screening did you see? Do you have a ticket as proof?

dialogue.speaker: char_rulan
dialogue.t: It was the 18:30 screening. The ticket stub... I haven't thrown it away yet. Do you need it...?

dialogue.speaker: char_rulan
dialogue.t: The movie was good. It ended a little before eight, so I went home.

dialogue.speaker: none
dialogue.t: I hear you went to the restroom for quite a long time midway through.

dialogue.speaker: char_rulan
dialogue.t: Yes. During the movie my stomach started hurting a bit, and later I really couldn't hold it anymore, so I went out to use the restroom.

dialogue.speaker: none
dialogue.t: About what part of the plot was playing when you went to the restroom?

dialogue.speaker: char_rulan
dialogue.t: It was around... after the Pumpkin King stole the magic wand from the museum...

dialogue.speaker: char_rulan
dialogue.t: I didn't find out until yesterday that he had already...

dialogue.speaker: char_zhencheng
dialogue.t: I don't know anything about that.

dialogue.speaker: char_zhencheng
dialogue.t: Stealing phones and so on has nothing to do with me. Didn't you already catch the thief?

dialogue.speaker: none
dialogue.t: Why did you and Victor steal tourists' belongings?

dialogue.speaker: char_zhencheng
dialogue.t: H-how did you find out?

dialogue.speaker: none
dialogue.t: Anton Han, the pickpocket caught today, said so. He said Aiden had known about what you and Victor were doing for a long time.

dialogue.speaker: char_zhencheng
dialogue.t: Wh-what? Aiden? He really makes me mad...

dialogue.speaker: char_zhencheng
dialogue.t: If he didn't want us to continue, he could have come straight to me and Victor to say so, couldn't he? What was the point of stabbing us in the back? Seriously, enough already.

dialogue.speaker: none
dialogue.t: So you really were stealing tourists' belongings with Victor? Why?

dialogue.speaker: char_zhencheng
dialogue.t: Heh. Do you know, the haunted house props are often stolen or damaged? It's happened so many times.

dialogue.speaker: char_zhencheng
dialogue.t: Do you have any idea how annoying those rowdy adults and children crashing around everywhere are?

dialogue.speaker: char_zhencheng
dialogue.t: Masks have gone missing three times, light stands have been knocked over four times, and there have been countless little trinkets and decorations... Every time something goes wrong, we have to fill out a Prop Damage/Loss Report Form in duplicate: one copy to the Performance Department, one to Operations. It's absolutely maddening.

dialogue.speaker: char_zhencheng
dialogue.t: The Performance Department tells us to watch the props more carefully ourselves, while Operations says performance props are the Performance Department's responsibility. They pass the buck back and forth, and no one will help us add a barrier, post a conspicuous notice, or remind visitors over the PA to watch the show respectfully.

dialogue.speaker: char_zhencheng
dialogue.t: Victor went to Ray about it. Ray had a good attitude and said he'd coordinate with Operations later. And then? Nothing happened.

dialogue.speaker: char_zhencheng
dialogue.t: Later I heard from a coworker that he did coordinate with them, but Operations felt adding barriers would affect the visitor experience, and every other measure was rejected too. So Ray just spinelessly squeezed the Performance Department's budget to buy backup props.

dialogue.speaker: char_zhencheng
dialogue.t: Victor and I were really angry. One time while drinking, Victor suggested that we mess with the tourists too.

dialogue.speaker: char_zhencheng
dialogue.t: In reality, we only took a few small things! And we were never caught! Compared to the backup props that cost so much money, these things hardly count for anything, right?

dialogue.speaker: char_zhencheng
dialogue.t: As far as coworkers go, I think Daniel Xiao maintained ordinary coworker relationships with everyone. It didn't seem like he was especially close to anyone.

dialogue.speaker: char_zhencheng
dialogue.t: I heard he had a girlfriend, but I've never met her and don't know her.

dialogue.speaker: none
dialogue.t: Who did you hear he had a girlfriend from? Did Daniel mention it himself?

dialogue.speaker: char_zhencheng
dialogue.t: He mentioned it himself. He said he and his girlfriend had a very good relationship and brought up wanting to get married. What was her name again? Hmm...

dialogue.speaker: none
dialogue.t: Was it Lynn Zhao?

dialogue.speaker: char_zhencheng
dialogue.t: Now that you say that, it does sound like a similar name.

dialogue.speaker: none
dialogue.t: Although you've never met her, did you ever hear Daniel mention her job, age, or how they met?

dialogue.speaker: char_zhencheng
dialogue.t: Hmm... I don't really remember...

dialogue.speaker: none
dialogue.t: Any small details from daily life would help too.

dialogue.speaker: char_zhencheng
dialogue.t: Hmm... oh, I just remembered one thing. Maybe his girlfriend wasn't in very good health? I heard she often went to the hospital for injections. Whenever Daniel brought it up, he looked really concerned. Their relationship must have been pretty good.

dialogue.speaker: char_zhencheng
dialogue.t: I saw the posts online too, but what does that have to do with me?

dialogue.speaker: none
dialogue.t: But you were dealing with something similar back then, weren't you?

dialogue.speaker: char_zhencheng
dialogue.t: Dealing with what? Because of whom? Say it clearly.

dialogue.speaker: none
dialogue.t: Do you know this Jasper Wang?

dialogue.speaker: char_zhencheng
dialogue.t: ...No, I don't.

dialogue.speaker: none
dialogue.t: Judging by your expression, it doesn't look like you don't know him...

dialogue.speaker: none
dialogue.t: You're the one who made that post, aren't you?

dialogue.speaker: char_zhencheng
dialogue.t: So many people complained about him. Why would you think it was me?

options.text: A Because the timing doesn't add up
C Because of the job duties

dialogue.speaker: none
dialogue.t: Because of the uniform. I specifically asked Andy about the park's rules regarding uniforms. Food-service staff and ticket inspectors represent the park's public image, so they have to wear their work uniforms in the park at all times.

dialogue.speaker: none
dialogue.t: And in that post, one line from the harasser was mentioned: "Your skirt is so short. Did you wear it on purpose for me?"

dialogue.speaker: char_zhencheng
dialogue.t: So what? Other employees wear skirts too, don't they?

dialogue.speaker: none
dialogue.t: True, everyone has skirt uniforms, but the key issue is...

options.text: A The length of the skirt
options.reply: Heh, you're right. Applause for you...

options.text: B The way it was phrased

dialogue.speaker: none
dialogue.t: Because of the way the harasser phrased it. He said, "on purpose" for him. Even if a food-service employee or ticket inspector walked up to him in a short skirt, he couldn't possibly say she was wearing it "on purpose," could he?

dialogue.speaker: char_zhencheng
dialogue.t: Ah!

dialogue.speaker: none
dialogue.t: During work hours, food-service staff and ticket inspectors must wear the park's standard uniforms. That wording only works if a woman in her own skirt walks up to him. Outside performance hours, only performers aren't required to wear uniforms, right?

dialogue.speaker: char_zhencheng
dialogue.t: I made the post. Happy now?

dialogue.speaker: char_zhencheng
dialogue.t: Celeste Ming and Jasper Wang have both been gone for so long. Even if you're sure I made the post, what can you do about it? Tell Ray? Have them issue a formal criticism saying I caused negative impact?

dialogue.speaker: none
dialogue.t: Being harassed and making that post weren't your fault. Telling the truth will only prove that you're a brave, outstanding employee who isn't afraid of authority.

dialogue.speaker: none
dialogue.t: I'm investigating this because too many doubts still haven't been cleared up. I want the complete truth.

dialogue.speaker: char_zhencheng
dialogue.t: All right. You're right. It's just that I've heard too many stories like that... After a problem appears, nobody solves the problem; instead, they go after the person who raised it... So I was really worried...

dialogue.speaker: char_zhencheng
dialogue.t: I'll talk... about that incident, and about Victor's connection to it.

dialogue.speaker: char_zhencheng
dialogue.t: That's right. That post wasn't about Celeste Ming. It was about that person in the admin team. I don't even want to say his name. Disgusting.

dialogue.speaker: char_zhencheng
dialogue.t: Back then... I really was often late, and he always used that as an excuse to call me into his office. Of course, it wasn't just me. Other girls suffered because of him too.

dialogue.speaker: char_zhencheng
dialogue.t: During that period, I felt that person was getting more and more out of line, but I didn't dare confront him directly, so I posted online.

dialogue.speaker: char_zhencheng
dialogue.t: After one rehearsal, Victor asked me whether I had made the post. So I told him about that person.

dialogue.speaker: char_zhencheng
dialogue.t: He thought for a moment, then told me not to worry too much and said he would find a way to handle it.

dialogue.speaker: char_zhencheng
dialogue.t: Only later did I learn that after work, he called a few buddies, put a sack over that person on his usual way home, and beat him up.

dialogue.speaker: char_zhencheng
dialogue.t: He also warned him not to harass anyone again. That guy was a coward. After that, not only did he not dare touch us, he was scared even when we got near him, like a filthy rat, always avoiding our eyes and scurrying away.

dialogue.speaker: char_zhencheng
dialogue.t: Soon after, he resigned.

dialogue.speaker: none
dialogue.t: But what happened with your post? When people hinted that it might have been about Celeste Ming, why didn't you refute them?

dialogue.speaker: char_zhencheng
dialogue.t: At first, I didn't respond to any of the wild speculation online. But...

dialogue.speaker: char_zhencheng
dialogue.t: I knew Victor was very resentful of Celeste back then. And several times, Victor told me he thought that person was annoying and wished he would resign soon too.

dialogue.speaker: char_zhencheng
dialogue.t: So I replied to the post with some ambiguous comments...

dialogue.speaker: none
dialogue.t: So this ended up being blamed on Celeste Ming, is that it?

dialogue.speaker: char_zhencheng
dialogue.t: Yes... I... I'm very sorry...

dialogue.speaker: char_ayou
dialogue.t: Uh, I don't know?

dialogue.speaker: none
dialogue.t: Enough. Stop making excuses. You know perfectly well.

dialogue.speaker: none
dialogue.t: If an actor were caught stealing from guests, not only would they be fined and fired, the show might even be shut down. Why would you still do it?

dialogue.speaker: none
dialogue.t: I'm guessing it had to do with that incident. Before Victor died, he often hinted to other people that you were connected to Daniel Xiao's death.

dialogue.speaker: none
dialogue.t: What he said probably wasn't just a joke, was it?

dialogue.speaker: none
dialogue.t: There's no point hiding it now. Daniel was wearing the Red Death costume when he was hanged from the crossbeam at Position 5. Please tell me the full story in detail.

dialogue.speaker: char_ayou
dialogue.t: I did hear about that. It was some kind of post, I think? I can't remember exactly what it said.

dialogue.speaker: none
dialogue.t: This is it, right? Take a look and see if it jogs your memory.

dialogue.speaker: char_ayou
dialogue.t: Ah, right... that's the one.

dialogue.speaker: none
dialogue.t: Do you think what's written here is true? Have you ever seen Celeste Ming talk to female actors like this, or make inappropriate physical contact?

dialogue.speaker: char_ayou
dialogue.t: Uh... no... or maybe I just didn't notice.

dialogue.speaker: char_ayou
dialogue.t: But I vaguely remember someone saying that another manager had behaved like that before.

dialogue.speaker: none
dialogue.t: Hm? Are you saying someone else harassed female actors three years ago?

dialogue.speaker: char_ayou
dialogue.t: Yeah... but that guy left soon after. I remember a few of the girls at work saying how relieved they were—finally gone, finally peaceful.

dialogue.speaker: none
dialogue.t: Which girls? We need to check that out.

dialogue.speaker: char_ayou
dialogue.t: Let me think. Mainly Lena Qiu and Gwen Gao. But they weren't in the performance department. I think I also heard Sunny mention it, though.

dialogue.speaker: char_ayou
dialogue.t: O-okay...

dialogue.speaker: char_ayou
dialogue.t: Daniel Xiao really didn't die by suicide...

dialogue.speaker: char_ayou
dialogue.t: His death was an unfortunate safety accident.

dialogue.speaker: char_ayou
dialogue.t: It happened on October 8, 2022. Everyone was preparing for the upcoming Halloween haunted house special event, and I had also started rehearsing for the performance.

dialogue.speaker: char_ayou
dialogue.t: Of course, I was responsible for some of the props, so I was one of the people going in and out of the haunted house most often. Back then, I often saw Victor directing Daniel and Sunny in rehearsal.

dialogue.speaker: char_ayou
dialogue.t: After Victor tried using a suspended mannequin as the Red Death, he wasn't satisfied. So he wanted Daniel to try performing movements on the hanging rope.

dialogue.speaker: char_ayou
dialogue.t: The day of the accident should have been his first time testing that. To get enough height, he placed a plastic stool on top of the box.

dialogue.speaker: char_ayou
dialogue.t: A little after four that afternoon, I was carrying things over when I saw the Red Death hanging from the overhead beam. At first I thought it was a prop and went to tidy it up.

dialogue.speaker: char_ayou
dialogue.t: Very quickly, I realized it wasn't a prop... one of his safety clasps had come loose, and the rope had wrapped around his neck. He must have accidentally kicked the plastic stool while struggling, and it fell to the side of the box.

dialogue.speaker: char_ayou
dialogue.t: His feet were honestly just a tiny distance away from the prop box, but that tiny distance cost him his life...

dialogue.speaker: char_ayou
dialogue.t: I quickly called Victor over. When he saw it, he was completely shocked. He asked me whether I had told anyone else about it.

dialogue.speaker: char_ayou
dialogue.t: I said no, that I had only called him. He then said that if this was classified as a safety accident, the haunted house project might not be able to open smoothly that year. And he would be the person primarily responsible for the accident, possibly facing the risk of being fired.

dialogue.speaker: char_ayou
dialogue.t: I said... I would help him with it. Because... at the time, he had encouraged me a lot, and I naturally saw him as an older brother. Faced with a scene like that, I said I would listen to him.

dialogue.speaker: char_ayou
dialogue.t: Victor came up with a plan. He had me remove the safety clasp and put the safety rope around Daniel's neck, making it look like a rope used for suicide. To outsiders, we would say Daniel had been overwhelmed and killed himself.

dialogue.speaker: char_ayou
dialogue.t: It just so happened that shortly before that, Celeste Ming had been dissatisfied with Daniel's performance and scolded him in front of many people after rehearsal. Victor used that as material, exaggerating the seriousness of the incident and telling people everywhere that Daniel Xiao had been depressed for days because of it.

dialogue.speaker: char_ayou
dialogue.t: In my heart, I had still been making excuses for what he did. But this incident showed me how Victor could twist the truth...

dialogue.speaker: char_ayou
dialogue.t: Later, the moment when he found the body kept replaying in my mind... At the time, I was overwhelmed by panic and fear... Whatever he said, I just did it...

dialogue.speaker: char_ayou
dialogue.t: Later, I realized more and more that he had calmly weighed the pros and cons and manipulated a person like a prop... Is that really how a normal person would react? I felt a chill run through me.

dialogue.speaker: char_ayou
dialogue.t: After that... I grew more and more distant from him, and his attitude toward me became worse and worse. I felt that things couldn't go on like this...

dialogue.speaker: char_ayou
dialogue.t: I hoped the park would discover what Victor and the others were doing. Whether that meant punishment, firing them, or even firing me along with them... I didn't want to keep acting like this anymore.

dialogue.speaker: char_ayou
dialogue.t: But... I hesitated a lot... If I spoke up, would Victor keep smearing me? If I said Victor had ordered me to do it, would anyone really believe me? Would he turn around and bite back at me? I was too afraid... so I kept silent the whole time... I-I'm truly sorry...

dialogue.speaker: none
dialogue.t: Why did you help Victor to that extent?

dialogue.speaker: char_ayou
dialogue.t: This might sound a little ridiculous, but ever since I was young, I've been interested in performing on stage.

dialogue.speaker: char_ayou
dialogue.t: But my family thought becoming an actor was a pipe dream. And I look very ordinary, so I had no confidence in myself.

dialogue.speaker: char_ayou
dialogue.t: After I came here, during breaks from making props, I would often watch Daniel and Sunny rehearse, completely fascinated. Then Victor asked me whether I wanted to join the actor team, saying the three actors allocated by the park made the schedule rather tight.

dialogue.speaker: char_ayou
dialogue.t: I was beyond excited! I agreed right away. I was willing to put in extra hours to practice, and I would also continue doing my work for the props team well.

dialogue.speaker: char_ayou
dialogue.t: Victor was very pleased with that. He said that even ordinary people with average talent had the right to pursue their dreams, and that he was willing to give me a chance.

dialogue.speaker: char_ayou
dialogue.t: He was like me: no degree, no background, no professional training. He had made it this far purely on passion and a refusal to give up.

dialogue.speaker: char_ayou
dialogue.t: Back then, he probably saw his former self in me.

dialogue.speaker: none
dialogue.t: In that sense, Victor really was someone who changed your life.

dialogue.speaker: char_ayou
dialogue.t: Yes. I also had no real way to repay him, so in that incident... I chose to cover up the truth together with him. It was only later that I realized how terribly wrong I had been.
